perItemFindings.label: S1
perItemFindings.one_line: `FullView T := Fin T -> FullStep` contains only S₁,…,S_T, but `PomdpKernelLaw` is proposed for every `t : Fin T` with next block `(Y_t,X_{t+1},H_{t+1})`; the terminal transition/state S_{T+1} is absent, so the local compProd world cannot realize the core sampling model.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S1's local trajectory carrier and its history projections: carry T actions/rewards together with T+1 joint states (or an equivalent endpoint-inclusive representation), then state the compProd factorization against that carrier. This is an encoding/world defect, not a defect in the core mathematics.
